summary: This code defines a function that greets someone by name, or says 'Hello World!' if no name is provided. It then calls that function and prints the result to the screen.

explanations.3: The function parameter has a default value of an empty string, so if you call sayHello() without arguments, $firstname will be empty rather than causing an error.
explanations.5: This is a ternary operator—a compact if-else. It checks if $firstname is empty; if so, return 'Hello World!', otherwise return 'Hello ' concatenated with the name using the dot operator.
explanations.8: The echo statement sends the returned string from sayHello() directly to output; since no argument was passed, it uses the default empty string and prints 'Hello World!'.
